changelog:
What's new
- Git status in the Explorer: changed files get a colour and a status letter, folders a dot, and a recap row shows the branch, ahead/behind and change counts. m / Shift+m jump between changed rows.
- Reveal in File Explorer: o (or the right-click menu) on any file, folder or the root.

Fixes
- Ctrl+A then Ctrl+V now splits even when the clipboard is empty or holds an image or files.
- Dragging a divider between panes resizes again instead of starting a text selection.
- The Explorer shows changes on disk right away, including in collapsed or scrolled-away folders.
